front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Protection Profile for OPC UA Secure Conversation

abstract.t:
This document specifies an experimental post-quantum cryptographic protection profile for the OPC Unified Architecture Secure Conversation protocol (OPC UA UASC) carried over the opc.tcp transport. The profile uses ML-KEM-768 for SecureChannel key establishment, ML-DSA for asymmetric signatures, HKDF-SHA-256 for key derivation, and AES-256-GCM for symmetric message protection. It defines the profile identifiers, nonce encoding, key schedule, authenticated-encryption inputs, certificate and public-key binding requirements, token rollover behavior, and implementation and interoperability requirements.
The profile is derived from an experimental open62541 implementation and is intended to support interoperability experiments and review in the IOT Operations Working Group. The identifiers and wire behavior in this document are provisional. This document does not assign an official OPC UA SecurityPolicy identifier and does not claim conformance with an OPC Foundation specification.
